overview: Based on the published agenda, the Wausau School District Board of Education was scheduled to convene for a special meeting on November 23, 2026, primarily to consider contract-related matters in closed session. The board was expected to evaluate contracts and review administrator contracts under state open meetings law exemptions, with potential follow-up actions in open session.

agenda.item: Request for Closed Session Pursuant to State Statutes
Consideration of contracts for Preliminary Notice of Non-renewal ss. 19.85(1)(c)
Reconvene in Open Session, to take further action if necessary and appropriate

discussions.body: The board was scheduled to evaluate contracts in closed session pursuant to Wisconsin state statute 19.85(1)(e)(g), which permits discussion of contract matters in private session before any potential public action.

discussions.item: Consideration of contracts for Preliminary Notice of Non-renewal ss. 19.85(1)(c)
discussions.body: The board was expected to consider contracts for preliminary notice of non-renewal under state statute 19.85(1)(c), which allows closed-session discussion of personnel and contract matters related to employee evaluations and renewals.

The board was scheduled to review administrator contracts in closed session under state statute 19.85(1)(c), potentially addressing renewal, evaluation, or other contract considerations for district administrative staff.

publicComment: No public comment period was included on this agenda.
actionItems: Board was expected to convene in closed session to evaluate and review contracts
Board was expected to consider preliminary notice of non-renewal for contracts
Board was expected to reconvene in open session and take further action if necessary and appropriate
title: Special Meeting - 2026-11-23
